335:t_1:86.en:
$n
「Then I'll look forward to our hero turning the tables.」

335:t_1:87.en:
$$桂$$
「You've learned to talk back, $n. I'm glad you're growing up so well.」

335:t_1:88.en:
$$桂$$
「Is this another result of those private lessons, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

335:t_1:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

335:t_1:91.en:
$$研究員$$
「...May we get started now, $$桂$$?」

335:t_1:92.en:
$$桂$$
「My apologies. ...Here's the communications code for Dr. $$トライア$$.」

335:t_1:93.en:
$$研究員$$
「Thank you. Now we can contact the doctor.」

335:t_1:94.en:
$$研究員$$
「Even this lab is restricted from sending transmissions to her.」

335:t_1:95.en:
$$五飛$$
「They go that far to conceal the doctor's location?」

335:t_1:96.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah. Since she broke the $$時の牢獄$$, $$サイデリアル$$ has been after her too.」

335:t_1:97.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Does it mean something that the doctor contacted us?」

335:t_1:98.en:
$$桂$$
「Apparently there's something she wants to tell you. I don't know what it is either.」

335:t_1:99.en:
$$研究員$$
「We have a connection to the doctor. I'll put her on the front monitor.」

335:t_1:100.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Hello, hello. Calling the world, please respond. Is the code connecting properly?」

335:t_1:102.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You've brought out $$おコンさん$$ right from the start?!」

335:t_1:103.en:
$$トライア$$
「Now, don't mind it. This is something of a ritual.」

335:t_1:104.en:
$$トライア$$
「But I'm relieved to see you all looking well.」

335:t_1:105.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$c's strength is below fifty percent of what it was at the $$時空震動$$ in $$第２新東京市$$, though.」

335:t_1:106.en:
$$トライア$$
「...About that. I need you to steel yourselves for the battles ahead.」

335:t_1:108.en:
$$トライア$$
「It pains me a little to bring this up as soon as I see you, but...」

335:t_1:109.en:
$$トライア$$
「Our data shows a momentary distortion of the dimensional boundary at the galactic center, corresponding to the $$時空震動$$ in $$第２新東京市$$.」

335:t_1:111.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So they were transported to the galactic center.」

335:t_1:113.en:
$$桂$$
「You say that so casually, but at that distance, even the $$マクロス・クォーター$$'s Fold couldn't bring them back easily.」

335:t_1:114.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's why I told you to steel yourselves.」

335:t_1:115.en:
$n
「...So we have to fight $$サイデリアル$$ on our own...」

335:t_1:118.en:
$$五飛$$
「Did you call us here to tell us that?」

335:t_1:119.en:
$$トライア$$
「That isn't all. ...What I'm about to tell you is fairly good news.」

335:t_1:120.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a relief. I couldn't take one depressing story after another.」

335:t_1:122.en:
$$トライア$$
「Have you heard about the ancient ruins found in 《$$リモネシア$$》 near the end of the $$時獄戦役$$?」

335:t_1:123.en:
$$マオ$$
「Now that you mention it, I did hear something like that...」

335:t_1:124.en:
$$トライア$$
「We've learned that they were built by the 《$$プロトカルチャー$$》.」

335:t_1:125.en:
$$カレン$$
「What is the $$プロトカルチャー$$?」

335:t_1:126.en:
$n
「Wait! Isn't the $$プロトカルチャー$$ a prehistoric civilization from $$アルト$$'s world?!」

335:t_1:127.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I hear they built a civilization long ago, created the warrior race $$ゼントラーディ$$, and uplifted the ancestors of Earth's humans.」

335:t_1:128.en:
$$トライア$$
「Thanks for the explanation, Miss $$スズネ$$. In simple terms, that's just as you said.」

335:t_1:129.en:
$$トライア$$
「Apparently the $$プロトカルチャー$$ also came to $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$リモネシア$$, crossing the barrier between parallel worlds.」

335:t_1:130.en:
$$トライア$$
「I suspected it after someone from the $$フロンティア船団$$ told me their Earth's $$プロトカルチャー$$ island was in the same location as $$リモネシア$$, but...」

335:t_1:131.en:
$$トライア$$
「The remaining systems and language make it almost certain that they left those ruins.」

335:t_1:132.en:
$$トライア$$
「And they left a useful message for us in later ages.」

335:t_1:134.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's what you wanted to tell us, Doctor...」

335:t_1:135.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What exactly does it say...?」

335:t_1:136.en:
$$トライア$$
「It explains the mechanism of the universe's collapse once every twelve thousand years.」

335:t_1:138.en:
$$トライア$$
「The end of the universe... Apparently, it means erasing the power of life from the universe.」

335:t_1:140.en:
$$カトル$$
「That phrase... People often use it to describe $$バサラ$$.」

335:t_1:141.en:
$$トライア$$
「From the records left in the ruins, it seems to mean something more universal.」

335:t_1:142.en:
$$トライア$$
「All living things possess it. It is also the key to drawing out the laws of all things, the $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

335:t_1:145.en:
$n
「It's true that $$スフィア$$s draw out $$次元力|lc$$ through people's feelings and hearts, but...」

335:t_1:146.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I see... I'm starting to understand.)

335:t_1:148.en:
$$トライア$$
「According to the $$プロトカルチャー$$, when the universe seeks rebirth once every twelve thousand years...」

335:t_1:149.en:
$$トライア$$
「Two energies clash: the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist.」

335:t_1:150.en:
$$トライア$$
「To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life, and...」

335:t_1:153.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So the end of the universe and $$バアル$$ really were connected...」

335:t_1:155.en:
$$トライア$$
「But living beings do not perish... Through blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire, and the sun's radiance, they walk the path of $$シンカ$$...」

335:t_1:156.en:
$$トライア$$
「This '$$シンカ$$' seems to have a different nuance from the 'evolution' we speak of.」

335:t_1:158.en:
$$トライア$$
「You seem interested in this sort of thing, $n. ...I suppose it runs in your blood.」

335:t_1:160.en:
$$トライア$$
「Sorry, but I looked into quite a few things about you after you became a $$リアクター$$.」

335:t_1:161.en:
$$トライア$$
「Your mother, Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$, published ambitious papers on archaeology as well as super-dimensional physics.」

335:t_1:164.en:
$n
「...I'm sorry, Doctor. I... went to live with my father when I was six, so...」

335:t_1:165.en:
$$トライア$$
「...That's right. I'm sorry I brought up something unnecessary.」
